_doc: Dependency CVEs we know about, cannot fix yet, and track on a backlog card. review_gate.py lists them as one summary line instead of re-flagging each on every PR. Matching is by exact CVE id AND package, so a NEW CVE on the same package still shows. Each entry expires on review_by: after that date the CVEs are listed again until someone re-checks and renews or removes the entry.

tracked.reason: blocked upstream: every fastembed release caps pillow<13 (fix: qdrant/fastembed#830); all 37 are fixed in 13.0.0 and none is reachable: they need Campy to open, decode or save image files, or call transform/merge/morph/text-stroke, and Campy embeds text only and its one PIL use draws an in-memory icon (Image.new + ellipse)
